general: Shotgun plugs and a Migratory Bird Permit are required unless an exception applies.
Hunter education is required for anyone born on or after January 1, 1969.
Fields without special dates follow the statewide dove season, which opens at noon on September 1.
Fields can fill up. Capacity may be limited depending on turnout.

fields.name: Bogota
fields.directions: Go north on Hwy 78 toward Tiptonville for 7.0 miles. Turn left on Hwy 103 west for 1.2 miles, then left on Barbwire Rd for 2.0 miles. The field is on the right.
fields.days: Youth hunt September 5, starting at noon (NWTF lunch at 11, registration at 9:30 at the Orange Tent). Regular season from September 6 through the first and second segments.
rules: Youth hunters must be accompanied by a non-hunting adult.

fields.name: Big Sandy WMA
fields.directions: From Big Sandy take Hwy 69 toward Paris about 1.8 miles. Turn right on Hagler Ridge Rd for 1.3 miles, then right on the gravel road to the parking area on the right.
fields.days: Closed September 1 to 4. Youth only September 5, starting at noon. Open to all from September 6 for the rest of the first and second segments.
rules: Youths must be accompanied by a non-hunting adult.
Walk in from the parking area; no driving to the field.

fields.name: Camden WMA
fields.directions: From Camden take Hwy 70 east toward New Johnsonville. Turn right on Camden Landing Rd (also called Crockett Landing Rd). The field is about a mile down.
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.

fields.name: Cypress Pond Refuge
fields.directions: From Decaturville go east on Hwy 100, turn right on Mt. Carmel Rd, left on Pevahouse Camp Ln, then right on Cypress Pond Cove. Parking is at the end.
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.
fields.coordNote: TWRA prints this field's coordinates without a north or west marker (35.49078, -87.9844). We read them as north and west; check the pin against the directions.

fields.name: Eagle Lake Refuge: Bomprezzi Unit
fields.directions: From North Watkins off Hwy 51, turn left on Northhaven Dr, left on Circle Rd, left on Benjenstown Rd, then right on Billon Rd. The entrance is in the curve; follow the signs to parking.
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.
rules: The field is about 2 miles from parking. ATVs and UTVs are strongly recommended and allowed only the first week; after that, foot traffic only.

fields.name: Harmon Creek WMA
fields.directions: From Camden take Beaverdam Rd and Harmon Creek Rd to Harmon Dock Rd. Turn right; the field is about a mile on the right.
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.

fields.name: Horns Bluff Refuge
fields.directions: Off Haul Hay Loop Rd, Humboldt, TN.
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.

fields.name: John Tully WMA: Fullen North Tract
fields.directions: Take Hwy 19 west from Hwy 51 and turn left on Jim Fullen Shop Rd. The field is about 3 miles on the left.
fields.days: Youth hunt September 5, starting at noon. Statewide season after the youth hunt.
fields.coordNote: TWRA lists the same coordinates for this field and for Yankee Bar. Check the pin against the directions.

fields.name: John Tully WMA: Yankee Bar
fields.directions: Take Hwy 19 west off Hwy 51, turn left on Four Mile Loop, then right on Crutcher Lake Rd. The field is about 2 miles on the left.
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.
rules: ATVs are allowed on opening day only; after that, travel on foot.
fields.coordNote: TWRA lists the same coordinates for this field and for Fullen North Tract. Check the pin against the directions.

fields.name: Moss Island
fields.directions: From Dyersburg go west on Hwy 155 to Exit 2, turn left on Hwy 181 south for 12.0 miles, then left on Moss Island Rd for 1.2 miles. The field is on the right.

fields.name: Obion River WMA
fields.directions: From US 45E/TN 89 in Sharon go west on TN 89 about 5.6 miles. Turn left on Beech Ridge Rd for 1.2 miles. The fields are on the left.
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.

fields.name: Parker Branch
fields.directions: Off Hwy 186 between Trenton and Gibson.
crops: Four plots of 5, 4, 2 and 3 acres, all sunflowers, bush hogged
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.

fields.name: Reelfoot WMA
fields.directions: Take Hwy 22 out of Union City, turn right on Hwy 157, and go half a mile. The field is on the left.
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.

fields.name: Tumbleweed

fields.days: September 1 at noon, then the rest of the statewide season.

fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.

fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.
fields.note: TWRA lists this field right after Wolf River without a name. The name here comes from its directions.

fields.name: Henry County: Future Vision Farms
fields.directions: From Hwy 641 N go west 4.3 miles, then turn right on Hartsfield Rd for 0.4 miles. The entrance is on the north side.
fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies
fields.days: September 1, 5 and 6.

fields.name: McNairy County: Fair Farm

fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies

fields.name: Weakley County: Yeargin Farm

fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies
fields.days: September 1, 5 and 6.

fields.name: Bark Camp Barrens WMA
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1. TWRA helps with parking and field access on opening day starting at 9 a.m. Central.

fields.name: Cheatham WMA
fields.directions: From Ashland City take Hwy 49 west, turn left on Hwy 250 (Petway Rd), left on Griffintown Rd, then left on Headquarters Rd into the WMA. Turn right on Sulfur Creek Rd II.

rules: Open only for the first dove segment. Small game hunting on this WMA closes the day before, and during, every big game quota hunt.

fields.name: Cheatham Lake WMA
fields.directions: From Ashland City take Hwy 49 south to a sharp right onto Jamestown Rd and bear left onto the WMA. The field and parking are half a mile in from the blacktop.

rules: During late duck season the area is closed to all activities on Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays.

fields.name: Haley Jaqueth WMA
fields.directions: From I-840 go south on US 31A for 3.6 miles. The field is on the left.
fields.days: Closed September 1. September 5 is a kids-only hunt all day, with limited morning spots. Open to all ages on September 7 and on Saturdays of the first segment (September 12, 19 and 26; TWRA's page prints the last one as "26st").
rules: Juveniles register with the TWRA officer named on TWRA's page (Officer Hayden Cook).

fields.name: Haynes Bottom WMA
fields.directions: From Clarksville take Dover Rd west, turn left on Dotsonville Rd, left on Dunbar Rd, then left on Chester Harris Rd. The field is on the right.
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.

fields.name: J Percy Priest WMA
fields.directions: In LaVergne, turn onto Fergus Rd from Murfreesboro Pike. After 0.9 miles turn right on Jones Mill Rd. After another 0.8 miles turn right onto the gravel road with the Percy Priest WMA sign.
fields.days: September 1, every Saturday and Sunday after, and Labor Day, in the first and second segments.
rules: Shoot from staked positions only.
On September 1 positions are assigned by a drawing on site at 10 a.m.
Be at your staked position when shooting hours start, and check out when you finish.

fields.name: Laurel Hill WMA
fields.address: Across from 276 Napier Rd, Lawrenceburg, TN 38464
fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.
rules: No one may enter the field or save hunting spots until 11 a.m. on opening day.

fields.name: Mingo Swamp WMA
fields.directions: From Hwy 64 take Mingo Rd 3 miles west. The field is on the left.
fields.days: September 5 is youth only (ages 6 to 16), 30 minutes before sunrise to sunset. Open to all ages from September 6 for the rest of the season.
rules: On September 5 a youth hunter must be accompanied by a non-hunting adult.

fields.name: Old Hickory WMA
fields.directions: From Lebanon take Coles Ferry Pike to Berea Church Rd, then N Denny Rd. The gate is at the dead end of the road. (TWRA's directions text is partly garbled for this field.)
fields.days: September 5 is youth only. Open to all ages September 6, then Wednesdays and Fridays through Sundays of the first segment only.
rules: Youth gate opens at 5 a.m. and a handheld drawing for stake positions is at 6 a.m.; the hunt ends at sunset.
After opening weekend, park at the gate and hunt from staked positions.

fields.name: Shelton Ferry WMA

fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.

fields.name: Yanahli WMA

fields.days: Statewide season, opening at noon September 1.
rules: No hunters on the fields until 11 a.m. on September 1.
No parking in the boat ramp lot on September 1. There is a parking area at each field.

fields.name: Lawrence County: Freeman

fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies
fields.days: September 1, 5 and 6.

fields.name: Lawrence County: Mac Old Farm

fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies
fields.days: September 1, then September 5 through 12.

fields.name: Lincoln County: Williams

fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies
fields.days: September 1, 5, 6, 12 and 13.

fields.name: Marshall County: Vanhooser

fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies
fields.days: September 1, 5 and 6.

fields.name: Maury County: Toombs Farm
fields.directions: A quarter mile off Hwy 31 on Bigbyville Rd.
fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies
fields.days: September 7 (youth only, sunrise to noon), September 12 and 13.

fields.name: Wilson County: Bobby Howard
fields.directions: From I-40 take Exit 239 toward Watertown and head south on US 70 East for half a mile. Turn right on Maddow-Simpson Pkwy for 0.4 miles, then left on TN 266 South (Cainsville Rd) for 16 miles. Turn left on Oregon Rd for 2.2 miles and follow the signs to the public field.
fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies

fields.coordNote: TWRA prints this point two ways that differ by a digit (35.8199946 and 35.819946). The difference is a few meters.

fields.days: Opens at noon September 1, with the statewide season.

fields.name: Chickamauga WMA: Shelton Bottoms
fields.directions: Lamontville Rd in McMinn County, where Shelton Rd and County Rd 5 meet.
fields.days: September 1 (noon).

fields.name: Hiwassee Refuge: Blythes Ferry

fields.permit: Not listed for this field on TWRA's page. Check with TWRA.

rules: Non-toxic shot only.
No access by boat.
fields.note: TWRA lists 30 acres total, but the crops listed add up to 38.
fields.coordNote: TWRA lists the same point as Armstrong Bend. Check the pin against the directions.

fields.name: Hiwassee Refuge: Armstrong Bend

rules: Non-toxic shot only.
No access by boat.
fields.coordNote: TWRA lists the same point as Blythes Ferry. Check the pin against the directions.

fields.name: Hiwassee Refuge: Armstrong Ferry
fields.directions: Take Hwy 58 in Meigs County to Armstrong Ferry Rd and drive until you reach the Hiwassee/Armstrong Ferry WMA.
fields.days: All ages September 1 and 17; youth only September 12. Noon to sunset.
rules: Non-toxic shot only.
No access by boat.

fields.name: Jackson Swamp WMA

rules: Youths must be accompanied by a licensed adult age 21 or older.

No hunting within 100 yards of a dwelling.

fields.name: Forks of the River: Field 1

fields.days: September 1 (noon), 5 and 7.

fields.permit: Migratory Bird Permit, unless an exception applies
